title: Chargers vs. Las Vegas Raiders
description: The Las Vegas Raiders come to town for a Sunday clash at SoFi Stadium. The Chargers are looking to put on a show for the home crowd.

title: The Best Rivalry in Baseball: Dodgers vs. San Francisco Giants
description: Dating back to New York, this one defines the NL West. The San Francisco Giants come to Dodger Stadium for a Saturday showdown. This is appointment viewing.

title: Freeway Faceoff: Kings vs. Ducks
description: One of the best rivalries in hockey is back. The Ducks visit Crypto.com Arena with bragging rights on the line.
